title: Administrator rights needed

text.copy: You need administrator rights to copy {what} here.
text.move: You need administrator rights to move {what} here.
text.delete: You need administrator rights to delete {what}.
text.trash: You need administrator rights to put {what} in the trash.
text.restore: You need administrator rights to restore {what}.
text.undo: You need administrator rights to take {what} back.

howWindows: Continue asks Windows for your permission, and then CannonCommander carries on.
howLinux: Continue asks the system for your password, and then CannonCommander carries on.
declined: All right, without administrator rights {what} stays as it was.
